source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the range (PDF 195-196).

blocks.text: Range phailao ka sab se saada paimana hai: sab se bari aur sab se chhoti qeemat ka farq, range = Xmax - Xmin. Bari range ka matlab data zyada phaila hai; chhoti range ka matlab darmiyani qeemat ke gird ghana hai.
Misaal: umrein 25, 20, 22, 30, 42, 45 aur 50. Tarteeb: 20, 22, 25, 30, 42, 45, 50. Sab se bari qeemat 50 aur sab se chhoti 20, is liye maximum se minimum tafreeq karne par range = 50 - 20 = 30.

blocks.prompt: Range gumraah kun kyun ho sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh sirf do intehai qeematein use karti hai, is liye aik ghair maamooli qeemat ise bohat bara bana sakti hai chahe zyada tar data qareeb ho.

items: Range = sab se bari - sab se chhoti (umrein: 50 - 20 = 30).
